configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.description: Create and manage reusable REST API request profiles, and set the add-on logging level.

entity.label: Name
entity.help: A unique name for this profile. Used as the stanza name and in alert actions / the restprofilersend command.

validators.errorMsg: Length of the name must be between 1 and 100 characters.
Name must begin with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, and underscores.

entity.label: Description
entity.help: Optional human-readable description of what this request does.

validators.errorMsg: Max length of description is 1000 characters.

entity.label: URI
entity.help: Full request URL, e.g. https://local.me:2220/test?name=param

validators.errorMsg: Max length of the URI is 2048 characters.
URI must start with http:// or https://

entity.label: Custom headers
entity.help: One header per line in 'Name: value' format, e.g. X-Api-Version: 2. Do not set the Authorization header here; use the Authentication section below.

validators.errorMsg: Max length of headers is 4096 characters.

entity.label: Content type
entity.help: Sets the Content-Type header for the request body. You can type a custom value.

entity.label: Body
entity.help: Raw request body sent for POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE. The complete body is encrypted at rest in Splunk secure storage. Wrap values that must also be hidden in previews with section signs, for example {"username":"§alice§","password":"§change-me§"}. The section signs are removed before sending; use §§ for a literal section sign. With 'Send triggering results' on and format 'Custom template', this is the per-row template and may contain $fieldname$ tokens.

validators.errorMsg: Max length of body is 100000 characters.

entity.label: Send triggering results
entity.help: When On, the rows that triggered the alert are serialized into the request (one request per row). When Off, only the static request above is sent.

entity.label: Result delivery format
entity.help: How each triggering row is placed into the request. JSON/XML/Form go in the body (Content-Type set automatically); Query params are appended to the URL; Custom template uses the Body/URL above with $fieldname$ tokens.

entity.label: Result fields to include
entity.help: Comma-separated event fields to send (order preserved). Leave empty to send all non-internal fields. Ignored for the Custom template format.

validators.errorMsg: Max length is 4096 characters.

entity.label: Verify SSL certificate
entity.help: When enabled, the server TLS certificate is validated. Disable only for trusted internal endpoints with self-signed certs.

entity.label: Request timeout (seconds)
entity.help: How long to wait for the server before giving up. 1-600 seconds; default 30.

validators.errorMsg: Timeout must be a number between 1 and 600.

entity.label: Retry attempts
entity.help: How many times to retry a failed request. 0 (default) disables retries.

entity.label: Retry backoff (seconds)
entity.help: Initial wait before the first retry; doubles each attempt (exponential backoff). 0-300 seconds.

validators.errorMsg: Backoff must be a number between 0 and 300.

entity.label: Retry on
entity.help: Which failures trigger a retry. Connection problems (DNS/TLS/timeouts) are always safe to retry; 5xx/429 retries also re-send on server errors or rate limiting.

entity.label: Rate limit (seconds between requests)
entity.help: Minimum delay between consecutive requests within one alert run (per-row sending). 0 (default) disables it.

validators.errorMsg: Rate limit must be a number between 0 and 3600.

entity.label: Use proxy
entity.help: Route this profile's requests through an HTTP(S) or SOCKS5 proxy.

entity.label: Proxy URL
entity.help: Proxy address, e.g. http://proxy.corp:3128 or socks5h://proxy.corp:1080.

validators.errorMsg: Proxy URL must start with http://, https://, socks5:// or socks5h://
Max length is 2048 characters.

entity.label: Proxy authentication
entity.help: How to authenticate to the proxy itself (separate from the endpoint's Authentication method below).

validators.errorMsg: Max length is 200 characters.

entity.label: Proxy password
entity.help: Stored encrypted in passwords.conf.

validators.errorMsg: Max length is 1024 characters.

entity.label: Expected status codes
entity.help: Optional success criteria: comma-separated codes or ranges, e.g. 200,201 or 200-299. Empty (default) keeps the standard rule (any response below 400 is success).

validators.errorMsg: Use 3-digit codes or ranges, comma separated. Example: 200-299,302

entity.label: Response must contain
entity.help: Optional success criteria: text that must appear in the response body, e.g. "accepted":true. Empty (default) skips this check.

validators.errorMsg: Max length is 1024 characters.

entity.label: Username
entity.help: HTTP Basic auth username.

validators.errorMsg: Max length is 200 characters.

entity.label: Password
entity.help: HTTP Basic auth password. Stored encrypted in passwords.conf.

validators.errorMsg: Max length is 1024 characters.

entity.label: Token
entity.help: Secret token value. Stored encrypted in passwords.conf.

validators.errorMsg: Max length is 4096 characters.

entity.label: Token header name
entity.help: Header that carries the token. Default: Authorization.

validators.errorMsg: Max length is 100 characters.

entity.label: Token prefix / scheme
entity.help: Prefix prepended to the token, e.g. 'Bearer'. Leave empty to send the raw token.

validators.errorMsg: Max length is 50 characters.

entity.label: Client certificate (base64 PEM)
entity.help: Base64 of a combined PEM (client certificate AND its private key). Create it with:  base64 -w0 client_combined.pem  then paste the single-line result. Stored encrypted; only used when Authentication method is 'Client certificate'.

validators.errorMsg: Max length is 200000 characters.

entity.label: Client key passphrase
entity.help: Passphrase for the private key, if it is encrypted.

validators.errorMsg: Max length is 200 characters.

alerts.name: rest_profiler_send_alert
alerts.label: REST Profiler: Send request
alerts.description: Send a saved REST Profiler profile request when this alert triggers.

entity.label: Profile
entity.search: | rest /servicesNS/nobody/rest_profiler/rest_profiler_profile splunk_server=local count=0 | dedup title | sort title | table title
entity.help: Select the REST profile to execute when the alert fires.

entity.label: Index the response as an event
entity.help: When checked, the HTTP response (status, headers, truncated body) is written back to Splunk as an event.

entity.label: Result index
entity.help: Index to write the response event into when 'Index the response as an event' is checked.

customSearchCommand.description: Executes (mode=send) or previews (mode=preview) a saved REST Profiler profile and returns the composed request and/or the HTTP response as a single event.
